messages:
marco: quick async standup — kernel / batching / KV cache perf update.
marco: what I did: merged microbatcher slot-allocation change (PR #4821). ran end-to-end perf sweep.
marco: observed ~8% throughput uplift on small models, p50 improved, p95 slightly higher on long seqs. eviction rate down.
ellie: can you paste the bench numbers + config?
marco: sure: 
```
model: gpt-small-8k
batcher: dynamic-slot-2
seq=512
throughput: baseline 1200 tok/s -> 1296 tok/s (+8%)
p50: 8.2ms -> 7.6ms
p95: 45.1ms -> 45.6ms
eviction_rate: 0.024 -> 0.011
cache_policy: LRU + async-prefetch (prefetch_threshold=0.6)
```
chris: p95 bump looks concerning — might be KV thrash on longer sequences. which shard did you test on?
marco: ran on shard-3 small-dedicated. saw extra KV lookups when slot refill coincides with prefetch.
ellie: hmm. can you repro the flake locally? the slot allocator test failing in CI was nondeterministic.
marco: repro steps saved in gist: https://gist.github.com/xxxx. suspect race in backoff timer. I'll add more logging and try flipping prefetch to conservative.
tess: I can take the canary rollout once PRs land. which pool and time?
marco: planning canary in us-west2 small-dedicated at 14:00 UTC today. tagging @tess to start rollout and monitor token latency dashboards.
bench-bot: perf job #perf-6012 (2026-03-17T12:34Z): p95 +1.2% on seq=2048 runs; p50 -7.5%; eviction_rate down 0.013. full logs in artifacts.
jen: I'll queue a quick code review and assign to @ellie + @chris. also will alert QA for smoke tests post-canary.
ellie: :thumbsup: will look at PR #4821 and the test flakes. ping when hotfix PR created.
marco: will open hotfix PR #4829 if repro confirms. also adding unit for slot_count to docs per @chris request.
chris: tiny nit: add a line about fallback policy in README (how batcher falls back to single-slot).
marco: noted, will update README + PR description. thanks all. /me starting repro run now.
